  <div class="chapter-card"><span class="ch-num">2</span><span class="ch-text"><span class="ch-title">Repeated-sampling intervals</span><span class="ch-does">Simulate up to 100 studies and count how many intervals capture the true mean.</span></span></div>

## How to use it

- In tab 1, change one slider at a time: a larger n narrows the interval, a larger s or a higher confidence level widens it.
- In tab 2, compare the share of intervals that contain μ with the confidence level you chose.
- The explorer works with large samples (n ≥ 30), where the normal critical value z* applies.
- Teachers are welcome to use it in class or set it as homework.
